items.claim: Mackenzie Dern has better grappling than Gillian Robertson.
items.quote: when you stack their grappling against each other, Mackenzie's is better, obviously.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern is a better striker than Gillian Robertson.
items.quote: I hate to say it, but I think Mackenzie is better on her feet as well.

items.claim: Gillian Robertson typically holds a grappling advantage over most opponents.
items.quote: usually she has the grappling edge over most girls.
